message.subjectLine: Subject: Lead delivery address for our {portal} account
message.body:
Hello,

Please start sending the leads of our {portal} account to this private address:

{address}

Please send each lead with {methods}. We accept the details as {formats}. The address already identifies our account, so no header, password or signature is needed. Please keep it private.

Please send us one test lead as soon as it is switched on, so we can confirm that it arrives.

Thank you.
